articles.summary: Vote.org was recognized today by the 30th Annual Webby Awards with a Webby People’s Voice Award for Responsible Information in the Websites and Mobile Sites category – an award determined entirely by the voting public. The honor recognizes web products, platforms, software, or technologies that are effectively working to combat disinformation, misinformation, and false or misleading information online.
articles.title: Vote.org Wins Webby Award for Responsible Information
